request.description: Records the person's choices against the template version the link was sent with (channel `sms_link`, linked to the lead). The lead's consent status updates shortly after via the worker. Public, rate limited per IP. The token comes from the SMS link (`CONSENT_LINK_URL?token=...`); it works once and expires after 7 days (410 `CONSENT_LINK_INVALID`).
